'''Reaver Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Marranis system/Legends|Marranis system]] held by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was a port for entertainment to be used for leave.
